title: Expect Increase Through Faithful Giving
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner shares a prophetic declaration of increase and blessing over The River Church's community, calling believers to stand in faith for their finances, businesses, and futures. As Pastor Chris prays over those who are unemployed, studying business, or seeking financial breakthroughs, he reminds us that our generosity and faithfulness will be rewarded with supernatural blessings. Join us as we listen in on this inspiring message of hope and promise for our lives and the lives of those around us.
